newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Ten killed in fresh clashes in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Ten killed in fresh clashes in Colombia.

text.p: Nine more leftist rebels and a policeman have died in heavy fighting sweeping parts of Colombia, officials said on Monday.

The most violent clashes took place late on Sunday and early on Monday around the town of Covarachia in the northeastern province of Boyaca, police sources said. Six Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels and one policeman died when a guerrilla column attacked a police barracks and the town hall.
Another member of the FARC, Colombia's largest and oldest guerrilla force, was killed in southwestern Cauca province during routine military patrols on Sunday.
Two rebels from the country's second largest insurgent force, the National Liberation Army, died in clashes with troops in northern Bolivar province, an army spokeswoman said.
A total of 34 guerrillas and members of the security forces have been killed in three days of clashes.
The heaviest casualties were reported in the banana-growing region of Uraba, in northwest Colombia, where 10 soldiers and eight FARC insurgents died.
